label: September 28 – October 4, 2026
intro: Doraemon has taken over Sea Life — grab tickets this weekend! Sunday brings a free family bike parade through the parks.
weekday_note: Thursday: Amarin Baby & Kids Fair at BITEC Bangna — free to enter, loads of hands-on kid activities worth a mid-week trip.

activities.title: Doraemon Adventure at Sea Life Bangkok 🐟
activities.location: Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, B1–B2, Siam Paragon (BTS Siam)
activities.price: ~790 THB adults / ~590 THB kids (book Klook for ~20% off)
activities.why: Doraemon and Nobita pop up all through the aquarium — sharks, rays, penguins AND cartoon pals. Pure win for a 5-year-old's imagination. Also counts as a building-and-making outing because the hands-on stations are everywhere.
activities.tip: Book Klook e-tickets to skip the Paragon queue. Weekday mornings are significantly less crowded than weekend afternoons. A perfect rainy-season indoor escape.

activities.title: BUCA × Kidical Mass — Family Bike Parade
activities.location: Starting: Lumphini Park → Benjakitti Park, Bangkok
activities.why: A joyful rolling crowd of families cycling through two of Bangkok's best parks. Thor will love riding alongside hundreds of other kids — pure festive energy and fresh air.
activities.tip: Arrive at Lumphini by 8:45 AM to register. Bring or borrow a small bike + helmet. Part of Bangkok Climate Action Week. Combine with a park picnic after.

activities.title: PlayTogether! Music & Nature Playgroup
activities.location: St Andrews International School Bangkok, Primary Campus, Sukhumvit
activities.price: Check BKK Kids for ticket price
activities.why: Music-making, movement, and outdoor nature play for ages 0–6. Thor gets to bang instruments and run around outside — perfect for his drum energy and love of being active.
activities.tip: Arrive a few minutes early. Great way to start Saturday and meet other expat families. Easy to combine with a mid-morning brunch nearby.

activities.title: Amarin Baby & Kids Fair Carnival
activities.price: Free entry (individual activity booths may charge small fees)
activities.why: Massive indoor kids fair — try-before-you-buy toys, hands-on activity zones, building stations. Thor can make things, play with demos, and discover new obsessions.
activities.tip: BTS to On Nut then taxi to BITEC. Go before noon to beat the afternoon school groups. Free entry = low-pressure browse.

activities.title: Bangkok Planetarium — Tuesday English Show
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit (near BTS Ekkamai)
activities.price: Museum free / Planetarium ~30–50 THB kids, ~50 THB adults
activities.why: 360-degree dome full of stars and space — watch Thor's eyes go wide. Feels like flying through the universe like Iron Man. The science center around it is free and has a pirate ship.
activities.tip: Tuesday English show only — arrives must be by 9:45 AM for a good seat. Museum opens 8:30 AM so explore before the show.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink — CentralWorld
activities.location: The Rink, Floor 2 Zone Forum, CentralWorld (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.price: ~260 THB/session (90 min, skate rental + helmet included)
activities.why: Thor's happy place — animal push-walkers for balance, smooth ice, coaches on deck. Most convenient rink in the city centre.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are cheapest and nearly empty. Helmet and skates included. Easy to add a BTS trip before or after.

activities.title: Roller Dome — SE Asia's Biggest Indoor Rink
activities.price: ฿50/hr or ฿100/day (skate rental + 15 min beginner lesson included)
activities.why: Huge smooth floor, AC, staff-included beginner instruction — Thor builds rollerblading confidence at his own pace without Bangkok traffic.
activities.tip: The ฿100 all-day pass is outstanding value. Staff give a 15-min intro at the start — Thor will be rolling solo before the hour is up.

activities.title: Clay Play Class — ClassBento Bangkok
activities.date: Multiple sessions — check website for current availability
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studio locations (see ClassBento for venue)
activities.why: Thor loved pottery — this is the easy, affordable way back into clay. All materials provided, small groups, award-winning instructors. A guaranteed afternoon win.
activities.tip: Book online at classbento.co.th to secure a slot. The ฿500 Clay Play class is the most beginner-friendly option for a 5-year-old.
